governance.ownerDirection: Full reference-system porting. Do not exclude or permanently reject any researched system unless the owner expressly decides.
governance.selection: After each engineering-accepted package, take the next lowest-numbered independently buildable QUEUED packet. If device, original runtime, merchant, source or owner policy blocks a specific gate, implement independent work, log BLOCKED_EXTERNAL or NEEDS_OWNER, and continue to the next package automatically without a prompt.
governance.rules: Do not silently modify existing immutable Deals, legacy saves, Undo/Hint, receipt ownership, source status. Own adapted mechanics must be identified as such and independently tested. No actual store payments without legally supported verified provider.
